_readme: Copy this file to ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json and replace all YOUR_* placeholders with your actual credentials.

supabase_mcp: Use env vars for credentials, not args
Requires three credentials: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
SUPABASE_URL is the base project URL only — no /rest/v1/ suffix
SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN is a Personal Access Token (PAT) from your Supabase account settings, not the service role key
Set PAT to never expire for a personal system
obsidian_mcp: Use obsidian-mcp package with local vault folder path
Do NOT use REST API URL — use the filesystem path to your vault
If MCP connects but shows limited tools, fully quit and restart Claude Desktop
npx may need a clean cycle to download and load the full package
Always test write operations in Claude Desktop, not Claude web
general: After any config change, fully quit Claude Desktop (Cmd+Q) and restart
Check Developer Settings to see MCP server status and view logs
Each MCP server must be a sibling inside the mcpServers object
